title: VISIONS Expands Citywide Support for Unpaid Caregivers Through New NYC Aging Contract
summary: VISIONS/Services for the Blind and Visually Impaired (VISIONS) has been selected by NYC Aging as the lead agency for New York City's comprehensive citywide caregiver services program under a new $1.7 million annual contract. Effective July 1, 2026, the award expands support for unpaid family…
body:
Our Vision is for Everyone to See what is Possible

NEW YORK, NY – VISIONS/Services for the Blind and Visually Impaired (VISIONS) has been selected by NYC Aging as the lead agency for New York City’s comprehensive citywide caregiver services program under a new $1.7 million annual contract. Effective July 1, 2026, the award expands support for unpaid family caregivers across all five boroughs, helping them care for older adults and other eligible family members through culturally and community responsive counseling, respite, education, support groups, and other essential services.

Under the new contract, VISIONS will continue leading the program in partnership with SAGE, Helen Keller Services, and the Center for Hearing and Communication. The citywide program supports a broad range of caregivers, including family caregivers as well as those caring for older adults and individuals who are blind or have low vision; are Deaf, hard of hearing, or DeafBlind; and LGBTQ+ older adults.
